Hello,

This is the same message as before, so our answer stands: please do not pay it and do not click anything in it.

It is a phishing attempt. We never send duty requests by email, and no payment is owed to anyone for a shipment linked to us. A genuine DHL duty charge can always be checked by entering the waybill number yourself on dhl.com, and it is never collected through a button in an image or a phone number in the message body.

The safest thing now is to mark it as spam and delete it. If you have already clicked the link or entered any card details, contact your bank straight away so they can watch the card.

If anything does need to move on a shipment of yours, you will hear it from us directly in this thread.

Best regards,
Sarah, HeliumDeploy
